name: AiLagoon
shortDescription: AI model hub with chat, local OCR, and PowerBox image creation
description: AiLagoon connects model providers through granted HTTP-out capabilities. Share chat, local document analysis, or explicit image creation with other pearls. OpenRouter image models accept selected PNG/JPEG references and return an inline image; provider charges and request outcomes are recorded without prompts or image content.
